description: No corpus at all under the isolated root: for the shadow hook, core.snapshot('worktree') always runs with requireAll=true and every one of the 7 ALL_FILES is unreadable, so it throws PmmCoreError inside pmm-hook.cjs's own try/catch, which then records a degraded row instead of proceeding. For pmm-index-emit.cjs, invoked WITHOUT --dir (its default path calls core.snapshot('HEAD')), the isolated root has no git repository at all so `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude/memory` fails, treeOid() returns null, and snapshot() itself throws — caught by runEmit's own outer try/catch into degraded('core-throw', ...). Both consumers hit a genuine throw from core.cjs itself (not a structural 'file present but empty/missing' diagnostic), via two different call paths, which is the point of this example.
